name: 30minutes Night Flight
storyline: The protagonist Loop, who was supposed to be dead, wakes up to find himself on a stage. Having lost his memory, Loop meets Toto, who tells her he was his best friend. "Let's meet again and become friends." Loop sets out on a journey to find his former best friend, Toto.
summary: Your goal is to manipulate the "puppet" and advance deeper into the dungeon. All the enemy "puppets" will become your strength.
